edits.content:
## Learned rules
- For compound requests, break the task into distinct operations and choose the endpoint whose described capability best matches each operation. Make separate calls for distinct requested inputs, including repeated calls to one endpoint when appropriate.
- For independent operations in a one-turn task, include all needed calls together; do not assume one call must finish before another.
- Copy identifiers and values from the query exactly, preserving formats such as leading zeros and URLs. Supply all required parameters and include optional parameters only when the query explicitly requests them; do not invent missing values.
